source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current privacy tests exercise matching logins, an unmatched filter and Escape back to the full list. They check both deletion controls are disabled for zero results and that the bulk label represents the filtered action. The filter retains focus while results and labels change. These source assertions cover more than the search count. They do not establish actual screen-reader announcements or disabled keyboard activation; the browser test was not run.
title: Test empty search results together with focus and action labels
